title: Deviation-Aware Pretraining for Cardiovascular Disease Detection from Electrocardiograms
abstract: arXiv:2611.14141v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals are critical for cardiovascular disease (CVD) detection. Most current deep learning models rely on supervised, task-specific training, which limits their ability to generalize across diseases, patient populations, and acquisition settings. This paper presents a self-supervised ECG feature extraction framework that learns from nearly one million unlabeled 12-lead ECG recordings. The framework includes two modules: Deviation Localization Embedding (DLE), which detects waveform-level deviations from normal patterns, and Association Reconstruction Embedding (ARE), which models cross-lead associations through deviation-guided reconstruction to capture abnormal patterns expressed across multiple leads. These modules enable the framework to capture subtle deviation-related patterns and their cross-lead context. The framework achieves up to 6.5% AUROC and 12.8% F1 improvements over prior methods on multiple public

translated_title: 基于偏差感知预训练的心电图心血管疾病检测
translated_abstract: 心电图信号对心血管疾病的检测至关重要。目前大多数深度学习模型依赖于监督式的、针对特定任务的训练，这限制了它们在不同疾病、患者群体和采集环境之间的泛化能力。本文提出了一种自监督的心电图特征提取框架，该框架从近一百万份无标签的12导联心电图记录中学习。该框架包含两个模块：偏差定位嵌入（DLE），用于检测波形层面相对于正常模式的偏差；以及关联重构嵌入（ARE），通过偏差引导的重构来建模跨导联关联，以捕捉在多个导联中表达的异常模式。这些模块使框架能够捕捉细微的偏差相关模式及其跨导联上下文。该框架在多个公开数据集上相比先前方法实现了最高6.5%的AUROC和12.8%的F1提升。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于近百万份无标签12导联心电图的自监督预训练框架，通过偏差定位嵌入（DLE）和关联重构嵌入（ARE）两个模块捕捉波形偏差及跨导联异常模式，在心血管疾病检测任务上相比现有方法显著提升了AUROC和F1性能。
